title: The Theft That Made the Mona Lisa Famous #shorts
description:
On August 21, 1911, Vincenzo Peruggia, who had worked at the Louvre, hid in the museum and walked out with the Mona Lisa under his coat. The theft was noticed the next day and the Louvre closed for a week. The painting was missing for about two years, until Peruggia tried to sell it in Florence. In 1911 it was not yet a household name; the theft and recovery brought unprecedented publicity and are often credited with helping make her world famous. A true story.
